sources.title: GitHub - 0xWhiteMage/Qwen3.8-27B-SGLang-Spark: Think-off SGLang overlay ...
sources.snippet: Serving Qwen3.8-27B (NVFP4) on an NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 with SGLang. Measured on a single 128 GB unified-memory box; every number below is reproducible from this configuration. The whole recipe is a .env file plus one start.sh you run. Everything else — kernel autotune, cache mounting, port, image — is handled by start.sh.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B on DGX Spark — think-off overlay + evals
sources.snippet: It is the measured think-off / agent overlay we run on a DGX Spark GB10, plus the evals that selected it. Apply recipe/champion.env on top of the official MiaAI recipe. Do not fork start.sh.

sources.title: Run Qwen3.8-27B as a Local AI Coding Agent in Just 3 Commands
sources.snippet: Running a capable 27B model as a local AI coding agent used to mean setting up inference servers, configuring endpoints, and connecting everything manually. With Qwen3.8-27B, Ollama, and OpenCode, the process is now remarkably straightforward.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: NVFP4 uses the real kernel here. vLLM selects FlashInferCutlassNvFp4LinearKernel for NVFP4 GEMM on sm120 — a cutlass path, not an emulation fallback — for both the Inferact build above and unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4.
